title: Did Yall Know AI Makes Music Now?
author: GodotDGIII

comments.author: Aggressive_Finish798
comments.body: Yeah. The AI owners trained it on thousands and thousands of songs without any consent from the original artist's and now it can create an endless amount of derivative songs. It can create hours of songs every day and people are making YouTube and Spotify channels with AI endless songs. That take away from real human artists. You know, the people it was trained on? Great. Just great.

replies.author: GodotDGIII
replies.body: It def fooled me. I was listening to a playlist on YT that was like 2hr long and it was killer. I read the comments and it was all AI. Regardless of how it came about this is really cool tech im impressed with was the point of the post.

replies.author: Aggressive_Finish798
replies.body: I will give it that. The tech itself is impressive.

replies.author: sonkotral2
replies.body: You also trained yourself on thousands and thousands and thousands and thousands of songs without any consent from the artists, don't you have any shame?

replies.author: Aggressive_Finish798
replies.body: I am not a LLM. Big difference. Are you a computer? Are you a car? Are you a machine gun? Different laws for machines and their specific abilities.

replies.author: PsychoDog_Music
replies.body: Suno doesn't even hide the fact they took audio they had no right to and put it in their plagiarism machine. And they actually charge a subscription for it...

replies.author: Veurori
replies.body: I guess its time to create AI that will recognize music paterns of AI music that was stolen from real songs to fill automatic lawsuits to become a billionaire.

comments.author: DkoyOctopus
comments.body: it has a "toys story" feel to it.

comments.author: thisisthemantel
comments.body: Ai enthusiasts are just people who don't want to learn a new skill or just too stupid to learn. They usually lean on I don't have money or time type of reasons. Technology is cool is a new reason.

replies.author: Mean_Establishment31
replies.body: Hard disagree. As someone who has all the traditional skills, the thing that is nice about it is actually that it is a completely new and exciting skillset. The more you know how to do things traditionally, the more you can do using many of the AI tools on the market now.

replies.author: thisisthemantel
replies.body: As someone who invested time into learning traditional skills, are you ok with someone who doesn't have any skill whatsoever just press a button and make something better than you ever could?

replies.author: Mean_Establishment31
replies.body: As long as it’s good and people are happy with it yeah that would be great.

comments.author: Yakky2025
comments.body:
It's like in this ad where people discussing AI:

\- what do you like?

\- I like painting!

\- Great! AI can do it instead of you now!

\- But I LIKE painting...

replies.author: ihatehappyendings
replies.body: Nobody is stopping you from painting. But for people doing other things that might need a painting, they might find it easier and cheaper to get that painting generated than painted.
